card.name: Words after 'even' and inside NSAID
card.fires_on: Words right after 'even' in 'even as late as' and 'even when used as recommended', and the ending of NSAID/NSAIDs. Also commas in lists of dose strengths.

modes.label: After 'even'
modes.description: Word that follows 'even' in a concession about risk or timing.
modes.example: even<< as>> late as two or more months after having

modes.label: NSAID ending
modes.description: The 'ID' or 'IDs' piece completing the drug class name NSAID.
modes.example: However, even short-term NSA<<ID>> therapy is not without risk.

modes.label: Dose list comma
modes.description: Comma or linking word in a list of tablet strengths.
modes.example: The recommended dose is 50 mg, 100 mg<<,>> or 200 mg taken orally
